page.overview:
Who is Crotaz'l?

Crotaz'l is a Saurus scar-veteran who restlessly patrols the jungles around Xlanhuapec, spending his centuries defending the city against the Undead of the Vampire Coast and the Skaven of Clan Pestilens alike.

Crotaz'l spawned at an auspicious time, when the planets of Charyb, Verdra, and Lokratia were in alignment and the continent of Lustria was beset by powerful storms. As the torrential rains lashed the plazas of Xlanhuapec, Crotaz'l emerged dripping from a subterranean pool and roared to the heavens.

Bright red scales arc from his snout to his tail tip, marking him as a sacred spawning of Sotek, a fact also evident by his drive to slaughter those who pose a threat to the Lizardmen's temple-cities. He is over 350 years old and spends most of his time joining skirmishes as he travels rather than leading any sort of permanent cohort.
